title: Smart Data Models - Mobility Data Specification (MDS) - Telemetry
description: A standard point of MDS vehicle telemetry (GPS/GNSS position and sensor data) during or outside a trip. (MDS 2.1.0, data-types.md section 'Telemetry'; field names kept verbatim; MDS timestamps are integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Telemetry:<telemetry_id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Telemetry'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

device_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/device_id'. A unique device ID in UUID format. Points to Vehicle entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Vehicle:<MDS UUID>).

provider_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/provider_id'. A UUID for the Provider, unique within MDS. See MDS provider list.

data_provider_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/data_provider_id'. If different than 'provider_id', a UUID for the data solution provider managing the data feed in this endpoint. See MDS provider list which includes both service operators and data solution providers.

telemetry_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/telemetry_id'. ID used for uniquely-identifying a Telemetry entry.

timestamp.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/timestamp'. Date/time that event occurred. Based on GPS or GNSS clock. Units:'milliseconds since the Unix epoch (MDS Timestamp)'.

publication_time.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/publication_time'. Date/time that telemetry data became available through the telemetry endpoint. Units:'milliseconds since the Unix epoch (MDS Timestamp)'.

trip_ids.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/trip_ids'. If telemetry occurred during a trip, the ID of the trip(s). If not in a trip, 'null'. Points to Trip entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Trip:<MDS UUID>).

journey_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/journey_id'. If telemetry occurred during a trip and journeys are used for the mode, the ID of the journey. If not in a trip, 'null'.

stop_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/stop_id'. Stop that the vehicle is currently located at. See Stops. (Required if Applicable.) Points to Stop entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Stop:<MDS UUID>).

location_type.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/location_type'. If detectable and known, what type of location the device is on or in. One of 'street', 'sidewalk', 'crosswalk', 'garage', 'bike_lane'. (Required if Known.)

battery_percent.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/battery_percent'. Percent battery charge of vehicle, expressed between 0 and 100. (Required if Applicable.) Units:'percent'.

fuel_percent.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/fuel_percent'. Percent fuel in vehicle, expressed between 0 and 100. (Required if Applicable.) Units:'percent'.

tipped_over.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/tipped_over'. If detectable and known, is the device tipped over or not? Default is 'false'. (Required if Known.)

gtfs_stop_id.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/gtfs_stop_id'. A unique stop ID to be recorded when a vehicle makes a stop event at a location. Matches GTFS 'stop_id'.

incident_ids.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/2.1.0/data-types.md#telemetry/incident_ids'. Array of one or more Incident IDs that are connected to this telemetry data point. Points to Incident entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Incident:<MDS UUID>).

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not an MDS field (Smart Data Models addition): a GeoJSON Point built from lng/lat of the MDS GPS object (mdsLocation), so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work. The MDS object is kept unchanged.

altitude.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters. (Required if Available.) Units:'meters'.

heading.description: Degrees - clockwise starting at 0 degrees at true North. (Required if Available.) Units:'degrees'.

speed.description: Estimated speed in meters / sec as reported by the GPS chipset. (Required if Available.) Units:'meters per second'.

horizontal_accuracy.description: Horizontal accuracy, in meters. (Required if Available.) Units:'meters'.

vertical_accuracy.description: Vertical accuracy, in meters. (Required if Available.) Units:'meters'.

satellites.description: Number of GPS or GNSS satellites. (Required if Available.)

accelerometer_x.description: The x-axis acceleration in G's (gravitational force). (Required if Available.) Units:'g'.

accelerometer_y.description: The y-axis acceleration in G's (gravitational force). (Required if Available.) Units:'g'.

accelerometer_z.description: The z-axis acceleration in G's (gravitational force). (Required if Available.) Units:'g'.

GPS.description: GPS / GNSS position and sensor data (MDS GPS Data object). WGS 84 decimal degrees.
